questions.stem: In a recent census survey conducted in a developing country, the government aims to measure the literacy levels among its population accurately. The survey team decides to calculate both the crude literacy rate and the effective literacy rate to gain a comprehensive understanding. What distinguishes the effective literacy rate from the crude literacy rate?

options.label: A
options.text: It provides a broad measure of literacy across all age groups.

options.label: B
options.text: It focuses on the population aged 7 years and above.

options.label: C
options.text: The literacy rate is calculated using the total population as the denominator.
